name: Miyako (Iwate, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Miyako city emblem in white: a ring with a bar at the top enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Miyako, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 6 June 2006.

features.role: Miyako city emblem — a ring with a bar at the top enclosing a stylised character
